summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.94/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.94 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 4, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 25¢ lower than a week ago, 34¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.07 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.72) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.19).
